2. “2019 United Kingdom general election in Scotland” – Wikipedia page; contains the list of constituencies that elected SNP MPs in 2019.  

Because the 2005 Order preserved 59 Scottish Westminster seats largely unchanged (the review mainly altered boundaries and, in a few cases, renamed seats), all 48 constituencies that returned SNP MPs in 2019 were already in existence in the same form (or by name only) in the 2005 Order. No SNP‑won seat required a boundary change or creation after 2005.
